## Common completion criteria

- [ ] Call the target entry points from ordinary arrays and confirm the native connection through both the LBT registration target and an independent reference / factorization residual. Success through the fallback alone does not count as completion.
- [ ] Verify the applicable Float32/Float64/ComplexF32/ComplexF64 and LP64/ILP64. Do not extend type families beyond what is defined.
- [ ] Verify the applicable shapes, leading dimensions, strides, UPLO/SIDE/TRANS/DIAG, empty / rectangular / rank-deficient inputs, and complex conjugation.
- [ ] Confirm workspace queries, the minimal legal work, INFO, in-place outputs, and interoperability with external factors. Do not read regions that are not referenced.
- [ ] Do not treat expert modes or dedicated algorithms missing from the numerical API as covered just because an ordinary solver exists. Separate the unsupported parts explicitly and record the fallback / usage conditions.
- [ ] Do not use Julia method piracy; limit native borrowing to the duration of the call.
- [ ] Pass `Pkg.test()`, the appropriate standard BLAS/LAPACK regressions, and the required Rust verification.
- [ ] Update the [routine mapping](https://github.com/AtelierArith/Colmat.jl/blob/main/docs/src/reference/lbt-inventory.md), the classification rules, the TSV, and the measured support table.
